components.purpose: Produce the additional low-voltage control domain from the qualified control rail.
components.modelRequirement: Future qualification must produce the declared rail with headroom, line/load, enable, startup, and overload behavior.

components.purpose: Provide output storage and load response for the additional control domain.

components.purpose: Filter the additional domain's reference/measurement path.

components.faultRequirement: Future admission: supported open or bounded value change only when the role changes live behavior, is physically serviceable, and is diagnostically separable.
